crossRefs.note: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you gone…
But at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite…

people.name: Armoni
people.line: Son of Saul by Rizpah, killed by Gibeonites

people.name: Meholathites
people.line: People from Abel-meholah, including Adriel and Barzillai.

people.name: Mephibosheth
people.line: Son of Saul and Rizpah, given to the Gibeonites.

people.name: Rizpah
people.line: Concubine of Saul; mother of Armoni and Mephibosheth

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite.
translations.bsb: But the king took Armoni and Mephibosheth, the two sons whom Rizpah daughter of Aiah had borne to Saul, as well as the five sons whom Merab daughter of Saul had borne to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite.
translations.kjv: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:
